title: Protective effects of Ganoderma lucidum spores on estradiol benzoate-induced TEC apoptosis and compromised double-positive thymocyte development

evidence_spans.quote: In this study, a mice model of estradiol benzoate (EB)-induced thymic atrophy was constructed
a mice model of estradiol benzoate (EB)-induced thymic atrophy
Thymic atrophy marks the onset of immune aging

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: Primary mouse study that tests an intervention against thymic atrophy explicitly identified as the onset of immune aging and reports a current-report multi-omics analysis.

causal_design_reviewer.exposure_or_intervention: Ganoderma lucidum spores (GLS), including sporoderm-removed GLS (RGLS), in mice with estradiol benzoate-induced thymic atrophy
causal_design_reviewer.comparator: Estradiol benzoate-induced thymic atrophy without GLS/RGLS treatment
causal_design_reviewer.outcome: Thymic damage/apoptotic thymic epithelial cells and T-cell development/output
causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: Improvement/effect of GLS or RGLS versus the EB-induced model on thymic atrophy and T-cell developmental outcomes

evidence_spans.quote: the improvement effect of GLS on thymic atrophy was evaluated
GLS effectively mitigates EB-induced thymic damage
attenuating apoptotic thymic epithelial cells (TECs) and enhancing the output of CD4+ T cells
the improvement effect of GLS on thymic atrophy

causal_design_reviewer.concise_rationale: The completed mouse study evaluates GLS/RGLS against an EB-induced thymic-atrophy model and reports between-condition biological outcomes; it also makes explicit mechanistic/directional claims.
